arc.opening: You mentioned the old boat at the lake house last time.

turns.text: You mentioned the old boat at the lake house last time. What was it like getting it out on the water for the first time each summer?
It always smelled like gasoline and lake water once we got the motor going.
Gasoline and lake water — I can practically picture that first pull of the cord. Who usually ended up yanking the motor to life?
Yeah usually my brother, he loved being the one in charge of the engine.
Sounds like your brother wore that job like a badge of honor every summer.
